title: Authorized local CI repair, same-suite comparison and separated qualified CD
user_story: An owner-authorized coding agent repairs actual assigned CI assertions without weakening gates or automatically modifying qa/main; branch evaluation uses identical recorded tests and policies.

requirements.description: Bind trusted assignment/state, genuine CI evidence, bounded native CLI repair and protected native dev merge
Compare fixed suite/environment/policy with complete critical denominators, not raw pass totals
Keep PR verification separate from exact qualified-main packaging/publication

nonfunctional: At most3 reserved CLI invocations per stable PR, including crashes
No credentials passed to CLI or arbitrary fork repair
Never weaken100% or count missing/skipped asPASS
No assertion of standards certification or scientific correctness
preconditions: Preserved worktrees and actual CI artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Actual repair stages have explicit real evidence, blocked stages remain blocked
Release verifies protected-main provenance/checks/tree and package hashes

scenarios.expected: Three reservations persist across changing commits and restarts
Missing state cannot reset an existing registration
Log payload stays quoted untrusted data
Duplicate matrix observations share a fingerprint without losing IDs/count
Dependency install precedes precise canonical worker execution
PR pipeline cannot deploy or overwrite PR status through dispatch
Privileged inline provenance matches separately tested code
Exact source and fresh web package exclude private data
Missing/skipped critical cases never count asPASS
Unstable source cannot be ranked from passing cases

recovery: Preserve raw failure. At most3 repair attempts per stable defect group. No waiver has been approved.
test_environment: Disposable local subprocess and file fixtures. Not live merge or AI acceptance.

review.method: Same-agent adversarial review, not independent approval

tdd.scope: Same final workflow test source against actual previous workflow:3functionalFAIL/1PASS, then GREEN. Supervisor policy fixtures are not live GitHub/AI proof; actual partially assisted repair evidence is separate. Initial missing-module RED retained, not called a behavioral reproduction.
